Title: Configuration checklist — once every row is green the purchase button enables within 2 seconds (new and edit mode)
Preconditions:
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:USER_DEFAULT]
[PRE:RESET_CART]
Storefront at {{FRONT_URL}}, signed in as {{USER_EMAIL}}, cart empty. Fixtures @td(CFG_WEDDING_CAKE_CONDITIONAL.name) (new mode) and @td(CFG_TEXT_DRIVEN_COND.name) (edit mode, line created in step 7 and removed in Cleanup).
Steps:
--- SCREEN: new mode ---
[NAV] Open {{FRONT_URL}}@td(CFG_WEDDING_CAKE_CONDITIONAL.url)
[ACT] Run an in-page evaluate step that installs a MutationObserver recording performance.now() for two events: the last red checklist row turns done, the "Add to cart" button loses its disabled attribute (timing is taken in the page, never from agent snapshots, whose round-trips take 1-2 s)
[WAIT] Page settles (UI and network idle)
[ACT] Choose a real option in "Creme"
[ACT] Choose a real option in "Message" so "Custom text required" appears
[ACT] Type @td(CFG_TEXT_INPUTS.customValue) into "Custom text required" (the last red row)
[WAIT] Up to 20 s for the button to become enabled
[ASSERT] Read the two in-page timestamps and compute the delay (button enabled minus last red row done)
[ACT] Make one more forward edit that keeps every required row done (choose another option in "Creme")
[WAIT] Up to 20 s
[ASSERT] Read the in-page timestamps again and compute the delay
--- SCREEN: edit mode ---
[NAV] Open {{FRONT_URL}}@td(CFG_TEXT_DRIVEN_COND.url)
[ACT] Type @td(CFG_TEXT_INPUTS.customValue) into "Engraving Line 1"
[ACT] Click "Add to cart" (creates the cart line, the URL gains lineItemId)
[WAIT] Page settles (UI and network idle)
[ACT] Clear the Engraving text
[ACT] Install the in-page MutationObserver again (evaluate step)
[ACT] Type @td(CFG_TEXT_INPUTS.customValue) into "Engraving Line 1" again
[WAIT] Up to 20 s for "Update cart" to become enabled
[ASSERT] Read the in-page timestamps and compute the delay between the row turning done and "Update cart" becoming enabled
[NAV] Open the cart
[ACT] Delete the configured line from the cart
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS error on the page under test
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on /graphql
Failure_Signals: All rows green while the button stays disabled beyond the 2 s QA tolerance (button lags the rows by seconds); lag grows after repeated edits; edit-mode Update cart lags the rows
Cleanup: Open the cart and delete the configured line created by this case; confirm the cart is empty
